assets.text_policy: contains rendered interface text in the reference itself; the reference is a composition target, not a shipped asset
assets.provenance: contributor-supplied composition target from the design conversation; not generated by built-in image_gen
assets.usage: The visual north star for the Cockpit: photoreal night driver POV, wet asphalt receding to a central vanishing point, cyan and amber instrument light, steering wheel foreground, right-hand console. A target composition, not a functioning UI and not a source of real telemetry.
assets.crop_behavior: Keep the vanishing point, the wheel rim, and the right console visible. Do not present it as a screenshot of live data.
rejection_conditions: It is presented as a real screenshot of live telemetry rather than a target composition.
The wheel, the vanishing point, or the right console is cropped out.
Colors drift off the night ground and the cyan and amber instrument light.

assets.text_policy: no interface text; a portrait reference only
assets.provenance: contributor-supplied mascot reference from the design conversation; not generated by built-in image_gen
assets.usage: The copilot mascot reference: black-and-white, straight blunt bangs, a wide white headband, shoulder-length dark hair with outward-curving ends, three-quarter profile facing left. A reference only. The mascot must be validated with the project maintainer before an upstream pull request, and no character is drawn or generated in its place.
assets.crop_behavior: Never composited into the Cockpit by this adapter. The copilot slot renders a ring and a COPILOT label until a real asset is approved and placed.
rejection_conditions: A generic anime character is substituted, even one wearing a headband.
The mascot is generated or approximated by a model rather than supplied as an approved asset.
The mascot is composited into the Cockpit before maintainer approval.
